text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Rice Shower and I wrap
up
training...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm just happy that you're all healed up...
And that
we can run together again.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My complete recovery is no doubt
thanks to my
research. I tested multiple
forms of treatment,
including those
involving geothermal springs.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Flustered and with tears in her eyes,
Rice Shower
hurriedly checks the
expiration date on the hot
spring
coupon. Relieved, we take a trip to the
inn
to use it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... the water felt so nice! And my
skin feels so
soft now.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! My legs are all warmed up
and feel
much more limber than usual!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I don't think there's a stretch I couldn't
do right
now.
choice_data_list: 温泉の効果が出てるな
温泉の効果が出てるね
choice_data_list_en: Looks like the hot springs did the trick.
Looks like the hot springs did the trick.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She stares at her legs gleefully.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's won quite a few races now with
them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hope this hot spring trip has helped her
feel a
bit refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: ずっと元気でいてほしいなって
choice_data_list_en: I just hope you'll always stay happy and healthy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: ずっと元気でいてほしいなって
choice_data_list_en: I just hope you'll always stay happy and healthy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But don't worry about me. These legs
can take me
anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I mean, they've carried me this far. Thanks to them, I've gotten through the spring Tenno Sho and the Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: With you by my side the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: With you by my side the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. So what should our next race be?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. So what should our next race be?
choice_data_list: ライスはどれに出たい？
choice_data_list_en: Which one do you want to enter, Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: ライスはどれに出たい？
choice_data_list_en: Which one do you want to enter, Rice?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We talk about our future plans for a
while.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Rice Shower and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
